page: OVHcloud r3-128 is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an AMD EPYC processor with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs running at 2.3 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via KVM virtualization, this instance features 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is supported by a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and the network interface delivers a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong memory performance, with the Passmark memory score ranking in the top tier (top 10%). Large-block read-only and write memory bandwidth tests both place in the top 25%, indicating efficient data throughput for large datasets, though small-block cached read-only bandwidth remains in the average range. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is strong, while multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench scores generally align with the middle 50% average. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and text processing benchmarks also demonstrate strong top-25% capabilities.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the r3-128 offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads without requiring expensive GPU accelerators. However, the 1.0 thread-per-core configuration means there is no hyperthreading, which limits concurrent execution threads compared to hyperthreaded alternatives. This server is well-suited for memory-intensive applications, including in-memory databases, caching layers, text processing pipelines, and medium-scale data processing tasks.
